How to choose a graphics card

Understand the part that renders your games.

On this pageVideo memory (VRAM)Memory bandwidthBoard powerNext step

Video memory (VRAM)

Stores textures and graphics data. More capacity can help at high resolutions, but capacity alone is not speed.

Memory bandwidth

How quickly the GPU accesses memory, measured in GB/s. Compare game tests as well as this specification.

Board power

A reference power rating in watts. Check the exact card’s connectors, cooling, and physical size.
